rules.text: Most Michaels purchases can be returned within 60 days of purchase.
rules.quote: If your Michaels.com purchase does not meet your satisfaction, you may return it within two months (60 days) of purchase

rules.text: Online-only costumes and accessory kits must be returned 7 days prior to the holiday.
rules.quote: except for online-only costumes and accessory kits, which must be returned 7 days prior to the holiday.

rules.text: Restocking fees may be applied for MichaelsPro returns.
rules.quote: Restocking fees may be applied for MichaelsPro returns.

rules.text: Check purchases require a 10 day waiting period for refund; within 10 days may be refunded on Return Card.
rules.quote: Returns purchased with a check require a 10 day waiting period. Check purchases within 10 days may be refunded on Return Card.

rules.text: Online purchases made using PayPal will be refunded in cash up to $500; otherwise contact customer care.
rules.quote: Online purchases made using PayPal will be refunded in cash (up to $500, otherwise please contact customer care).

rules.text: Exchanges are not offered; customers must return and place a new order.
rules.quote: At this time we do not offer exchanges. If you would like to exchange a product, please return it using our returns process and then place a new order.

rules.text: Opened trading cards are not returnable.
rules.quote: Opened trading cards will be considered damaged and are not returnable.

rules.text: Gift cards and prepaid cards are not returnable or exchangeable except where required by law.
rules.quote: Gift Cards and Prepaid Cards are not returnable or exchangeable, except where required by law.

rules.text: Sales of cut fabric are final and not returnable or exchangeable except where required by law.
rules.quote: Online or in-store sales of cut fabric are final sale and are not returnable or exchangeable, except where required by law.

rules.text: Clearance sales are final and not returnable or exchangeable.
rules.quote: Clearance sales are considered final, sold AS IS and are not returnable for a refund or exchange.
